chunks: Whether you do some good openly or in secret, or forgive an ill done to you, (know) that God is forgiving and all-powerful.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to forgive an ill done to you according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *sirr* (inner sincerity) versus *jahr* (public display), emphasizing that God’s acceptance transcends human visibility. It underscores the divine attribute of *‘Afū* (pardon) and *Qadīr* (omnipotence), encouraging believers to cultivate inner purity and graciousness in dealing with others' faults, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of modesty in worship.
